update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.27 - Career automation reliability fixes
Fixes --- - Factor-based legacy parent picks re-scroll to tap the correct row instead of stale coordinates - Scroll lists honor caller timeout instead of always using 60 seconds - Friend borrow OCR only runs on career selection (avoids false skip on other screens) - Scrollbar crop failure no longer falls back to full-frame detection with wrong offsets - Owned support equip re-reads each slot after prior picks land
Includes v5.9.26 career selection loop fix and prior hotfixes.
